Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. Management detailed ordinary and special business items, including the re-appointment of directors and independent directors. The document outlines procedures for electronic voting and attending the meeting via video conferencing. No financial projections, operational guidance, or market commentary were provided. During FY 2024-25, California Software Company Limited ("Calsofts") focused its strategy on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible artificial intelligence (AI) platforms such as dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that approximately 68% of small business owners report using AI, marking an increase from 51% two years prior.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: Management indicated that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered based on plans of additional users.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

demand_outlook.claim: Surveys showed that around 80% of small business owners view AI as enhancing rather than replacing their workforce.
demand_outlook.quote: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that generative AI adoption among SMBs reached 58% in 2025 compared to 40% in 2024.
demand_outlook.quote: 58% of SMBs reported using generative AI in 2025, up from 40% in 2024, with marketing as the top use case (U.S. Chamber Report).

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that 91% of financial services companies worldwide were either using AI or actively assessing it for production use in SME lending.
demand_outlook.quote: the SME Finance Forum reported that by 2024 a whopping 91% of financial services companies worldwide were either using AI or actively assessing it for production use, with SME lending identified as a prime area of opportunity.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps when deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively. This presents both a challenge and an opportunity – one that Calsoft has proactively addressed through accessible technology and client support.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted survey findings that 42% of small businesses reported lacking necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

management_commitments.claim: Management affirmed a moral and strategic responsibility to make AI accessible, affordable, and impactful.
management_commitments.quote: At Calsofts, we consider it our moral and strategic responsibility to ensure that AI is accessible, affordable, and impactful for the millions of entrepreneurs who need it most.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
